title: Pending Repair Validation Blocks Next Work Card Advancement
problem: The app routes to WC09 full Work Card creation even though WC08-REPAIR02 still requires Operator validation, preventing the Operator from validating WC08-REPAIR02 through the application.
goal: Ensure unresolved repair validation blocks advancement to the next mapped Work Card.
userOutcome: The Operator can validate WC08-REPAIR02 through the app before the workflow advances to WC09.
scope: Fix current-action evaluation for unresolved repair validation obligations.
Route WC08-REPAIR02 to Human Validation when Architect Review is ready and no repair validation exists.
Block WC09 creation while WC08 repair validation remains unresolved.
outOfScope: Do not create or fake WC08-REPAIR02 validation reports.
Do not merge to dev or push to master.
acceptanceCriteria: Current-action evaluation routes to WC08-REPAIR02 validation instead of WC09 creation when WC08-REPAIR02 has Architect Review ready and lacks repair validation.
Routed workspace is Human Validation, not Ad Hoc Work Card Capture.
Expected output is a WC08-REPAIR02 validation record.
Legacy Operator Decision remains advisory only.
Next Work Card candidate advancement is blocked until unresolved repair validation completes.
validationPlan: Add and run focused regression fixture for pending WC08-REPAIR02 validation blocking WC09.
Run WC08 report-protocol fixture if affected.
